newsitem.title: USA: U.S Oct payrolls report confirms economic slowdown.
newsitem.headline: U.S Oct payrolls report confirms economic slowdown.

text.p: The U.S. October employment report met Wall Street expectations and fueled a bond market rise as it confirmed the U.S. economy is slowing from last spring's breakneck pace, analysts said.

"This will keep the Federal Reserve on hold until yearend," said Kevin Flanagan, money market economist at Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, addressing a longstanding market concern that the Fed might soon raise short-term interest rates to subdue inflation and economic growth.
The hourly wage component confirmed a surprisingly weak reading of the third quarter employee cost index (ECI) on Tuesday, which sparked a 2-1/2 point rally in the 30-year Treasury bond.

"Anyone concerned about wage pressures gets a reprieve this week with the ECI being subdued and now with the fact that earnings failed to post any increase for the first time in at least two to three months," Flanagan said.
